article.headline: Teagan Moore scores 17 as Western Kentucky opens with 83-58 victory over Morehead State
article.description: — Teagan Moore had 17 points in Western Kentucky's 83-58 victory over Morehead State on Monday night in a season opener.
article.linkText: Teagan Moore scores 17 as Western Kentucky opens with 83-58 victory over Morehead State

keywords: Morehead State Eagles @ Western Kentucky Hilltoppers
article.story: BOWLING GREEN, Ky. -- — Teagan Moore had 17 points in Western Kentucky's 83-58 victory over Morehead State on Monday night in a season opener. Moore shot 6 of 11 from the field and went 5 for 6 from the free-throw line for the Hilltoppers. Gabe Weis added 14 points and Sharron Young sank three 3-pointers and scored 13. Chase Dawson finished with 13 points to pace the Eagles. Clayton Parker added 12 points and two steals. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
